description: This file defines authentication API endpoints for a FastAPI web application, including user registration, login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh. It interacts with user models, repositories, and database connection utilities, and handles user authentication logic with password hashing.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Handles user registration, hashes password, checks for existing email, creates a new user, and returns a token.

methods.name: login_user(login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, verifies password hash, and returns a token.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the current user profile based on trusted user identification.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile information.

methods.name: refresh_access_token(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Provides a new mock access token for the authenticated user.
